requirements.title: Card Freeze/Unfreeze
requirements.description: Allow users to instantly freeze or unfreeze their debit cards from the app, providing an additional layer of security and control over their accounts.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to be able to freeze or unfreeze my card from the app, so that I can instantly protect my account from unauthorized transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Card freeze/unfreeze functionality is available in the app
Card status is updated in real-time

test_steps.action: Launch the app and navigate to the card management section
test_steps.expected_result: The card freeze/unfreeze option is visible

assumptions: The app has the necessary permissions to access the card information
ambiguities: How will the card freeze/unfreeze feature handle pending transactions?

requirements.title: Spending Limits
requirements.description: Enable users to set spending limits by category (e.g., ATM, online, international), providing a way to control and track expenses.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to be able to set spending limits by category, so that I can manage my expenses and stay within my budget.
acceptance_criteria: Spending limits can be set by category
Transactions exceeding the limit are declined

test_steps.action: Set a spending limit for a specific category

test_scenarios: Transaction declined due to exceeded limit
assumptions: The system has the necessary categorization rules for transactions
ambiguities: How will the spending limits handle transactions that span multiple categories?

requirements.title: Rewards Program
requirements.description: Offer a rewards program that provides cashback on debit card purchases, with rotating bonus categories, to incentivize users to use their debit cards for daily transactions.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to earn cashback on my purchases, so that I can benefit from using my debit card.
acceptance_criteria: Cashback is earned on all debit card purchases

test_steps.action: Make a purchase using the debit card

assumptions: The system has the necessary integration with the rewards program
ambiguities: How will the rewards program handle returns or disputed transactions?

requirements.title: ATM Access
requirements.description: Provide fee-free ATM access at a large network of locations, making it convenient for users to withdraw cash when needed.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want to be able to withdraw cash from an ATM without incurring fees, so that I can access my money conveniently.
acceptance_criteria: Fee-free ATM access is available at a large network of locations
ATM finder is available in the app

test_steps.action: Use the ATM finder to locate a fee-free ATM

assumptions: The system has the necessary integration with the ATM network
ambiguities: How will the fee-free ATM access handle international transactions?

requirements.title: Location-Based Security
requirements.description: Enhance security by declining transactions outside the user's home region unless they are traveling, providing an additional layer of protection against unauthorized transactions.
requirements.user_story: As a debit card user, I want my transactions to be secured by location-based security, so that I can protect my account from unauthorized transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Transactions are declined outside the home region unless the user is traveling
User can indicate travel plans in the app

test_steps.action: Attempt a transaction outside the home region

assumptions: The system has the necessary location-based security rules
ambiguities: How will the location-based security handle international transactions?

requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to perform transactions, so that I can manage my finances.
